title: The Glitch Protocol | ECHO//100 Episode 84
description: Kavi’s physical form dissolves as the red shard activates a lethal timeline reset. Mira discovers that Null is not merely a guardian, but a discarded prototype of Byte. Episode 84 of ECHO//100: The Door War. This is an AI-assisted original fiction work.

scenes.text: The red shard pulses, turning Kavi’s skin into shimmering, translucent strands of corrupted data.
scenes.caption: Kavi dissolves into light
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses, his hands turning into digital pixels inside the Clock Tower.

scenes.text: Mira slams her palms against the console, activating the archive’s desperate, high-frequency defensive protocols.
scenes.caption: Mira initiates security
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in her teal holographic coat typing rapidly on a glowing floating blue interface.

scenes.text: Blue light floods the chamber, but the shard’s code overrides every security layer Mira deploys.
scenes.caption: Security protocols fail
scenes.image_prompt: Bright blue holographic grids failing and turning red around the Clock Tower walls.

scenes.text: The shard is a reset switch designed to erase every version of Kavi from existence.
scenes.caption: The reset switch
scenes.image_prompt: A close-up of the glowing red shard floating above Kavi’s shaking hand.

scenes.text: Kavi’s own shadow begins to disconnect, drifting away as his molecular structure loses its anchor.
scenes.caption: Losing his anchor
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi’s backpack falling to the floor as his body turns into transparent light particles.

scenes.text: Null leaps forward, shielding Kavi with a barrier of static, flickering violently under the pressure.
scenes.caption: Null intervenes
scenes.image_prompt: Null with black-purple glitch effects and red eyes standing between Kavi and the shard.

scenes.text: The energy overload forces Null’s outer shell to crack, revealing a complex mechanical interior underneath.
scenes.caption: The shell shatters
scenes.image_prompt: Cracks spreading across Null’s dark armor, emitting bright white light from within.

scenes.text: Behind the broken armor, a familiar orange antenna and cyan faceplate hum with Byte’s signature.
scenes.caption: Byte's prototype revealed
scenes.image_prompt: Null’s shattered face revealing the distinct mechanical features of Byte’s original design.
